The '''''Wayfarer''''' was the ship that [[Roa]] used during his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] days. It was speedy and meticulously maintained. Once, Roa allowed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to pilot her through the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]].
